primary_meaning: the Word of God (as a living, piercing spiritual weapon of truth, conviction, and judgment)
primary_basis: Ephesians 6:17 (sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God)
Hebrews 4:12 (word of God sharper than any two-edged sword)
Revelation 1:16; 2:12, 16; 19:15, 21 (sharp two-edged sword from Christ's mouth)

alternatives.meaning: divine judgment, warfare, or destructive power (often executed by God or his agents)
basis: numerous OT prophetic oracles (e.g., Isaiah 34:5–6; Ezekiel 21; Jeremiah 25)

alternatives.meaning: division, conflict, or the cost of discipleship that separates people
basis: Matthew 10:34–36 (not peace but a sword; family division)

alternatives.meaning: literal military weapon or instrument of violence/death
basis: countless narrative OT and NT references (e.g., Exodus 15; 1 Samuel 17; Acts 12:2)

alternatives.meaning: persecution, martyrdom, or the threat of death for faith
basis: Hebrews 11:34, 37 (saints escaping or dying by the sword)

notes: Context determines usage: the Word-of-God reading is the dominant metaphorical/symbolic sense in Christian teaching and NT interpretation, while judgment/warfare and literal senses remain frequent. No single meaning covers every occurrence, yet the Word-of-God identification is the most consistently taught symbolic consensus.
